name: cache_scaled_parameter_and_notify
description: Multiplies the low word of the first register input by a fixed constant and compares the product, a status byte and a second input with the values saved on the previous call. If any differ it stores the new values, calls a notification routine, clears a status global and returns both inputs.

name: call_routine_return_minus_one
description: Calls another routine and returns the all-ones value to the caller.

name: invoke_table_test_and_signal
description: Calls a test function through a pointer held in a global table. When the test returns nonzero it calls a second table entry with a fixed argument and then calls a notification routine.

name: run_guarded_table_call
description: When a global flag is zero, it calls a routine, invokes a function from the global table with the address register as argument, and then calls another routine.

name: xor_decrementing_key_block
description: Walks 78 bytes from the address held in the address register, XORing each byte with a value counting down from 78 to 1, and returns 78.

name: call_table_slot_return_inputs
description: Calls the function stored at a fixed offset in a global table and returns its two register inputs unchanged.

name: call_slot_100_return_inputs
description: Calls the function stored at a second fixed offset in a global table and returns its two register inputs unchanged.

name: walk_iff_container_chunks
description: Requires a buffer of at least 12 bytes whose first four characters are FORM, LIST or CAT, then repeatedly calls a chunk routine until the remaining size reaches zero. Otherwise it makes one call and returns the input size.

name: copy_words_to_output_buffer
description: Writes a self-referencing slot to the output pointer, then copies half the byte count, rounded up, as 16-bit words from the source into the output buffer.

name: parse_iff_chunk_recursively
description: Parses one IFF-style chunk by its four-character tag: steps over LIST chunks, recurses into the sub-chunks of CAT chunks, and recurses into FORM chunks whose form type is space-filled, HUFF or 8SVX. Other tags return zero or the remaining size, and the function returns the remaining byte count.

name: parse_iff_chunk_with_body
description: Steps over an IFF-style chunk by its size. LIST, CAT and FORM containers are walked, a BODY chunk is passed with its payload to a sub-routine, and other tags are skipped. Returns the remaining byte count.

name: parse_iff_chunk_into_record
description: Parses one IFF-style chunk and records the SIZE value, the CODE payload pointer or the TREE payload pointer into a record addressed by a register. FORM and CAT containers are recursed into, and the remaining byte count is returned.

name: decode_bit_table_symbols
description: Decodes a bit-packed stream with a 16-bit shift register and a table of relative branch offsets, writing one output byte per decoded symbol until the requested count is reached. When the buffer starts with a container tag it then walks its chunks.

name: parse_iff_header_and_body
description: Parses one IFF-style chunk. A VHDR header and a BODY chunk store their payload pointer in a global; the BODY path builds a record of sample count and loop values and then copies words, calls a routine or calls another routine depending on a mode byte. Returns the remaining byte count.

name: unpack_run_length_delta_stream
description: Decodes a compressed stream: a zero control byte emits a block of zero bytes whose length comes from the next word, a negative control byte expands packed nibbles into running-sum bytes, and a positive control byte copies that many literal bytes to the output pointer.

name: unpack_scaled_run_length_stream
description: Decodes the same control-byte stream as the run-length delta unpacker, but doubles every nibble delta and literal byte before accumulating or writing it to the output pointer.

Fine and extended effects use separate branches.

name: process_row_effect_command
